    Class WkbWriter

    Streaming little-endian 2D WKB writer producing the exact buffer pair an Arrow Binary makeData consumes: one concatenated bytes array plus per-row valueOffsets (length = rowCount + 1).

    Coordinates come from shared xs/ys arrays addressed by [start, end) runs — the coord-run model the export pipeline accumulates — so no per-vertex array allocation happens on the write path.

    Example

    Runnable example association: duckdb-geoparquet-query, export-geoparquet, export-roundtrip.
